+# MODULE: canonical_quant_pack
+SOURCES: tools/canonical_xcheck.py, tools/ref_pack.py, tools/mtp_pack.py
+Canonical code-plane forms of the GGUF quantization types (S2/S4/S8), bit packing of code planes,
+64-byte plane alignment, block-geometry consistency, and the MTP expert quantizer.
+## Source semantics
+* Each type decodes as `(code + bias) * scale` (+ offset), the bias being applied to the INTEGER code
+  before the single float multiply: Q2_0 -1, Q4_0 -8, Q5_0 -16, Q3_K -4, Q6_K -32, Q8_0 -128.
+* Codes are packed LSB-first, `8 / bits` per byte; unpacking recovers every code.
+* Nibble splits (Q4_0, IQ4_NL, Q4_K ...) put low nibbles first, high nibbles second.
+* Planes start on 64-byte boundaries.
+* The Q2_0 MTP quantizer maps `q` clipped to {-1..2} to code `q+1` in 0..3 and searches 17 scales
+  `amax * (16+k)/32`.
+
+## Form template identifiers
+* MAPPINGS -> type_mapping_table, code_bias -> integer_code_bias, ALIGN -> plane_alignment
+* pack_codes / unpack_codes -> code_plane_pack / code_plane_unpack
+-/
+
+namespace Ref.Pack
+
+-- § 2-bit and 4-bit packing
+/-- Pack four 2-bit codes LSB-first. -/
+def pack2 (c0 c1 c2 c3 : Nat) : Nat := c0 ||| (c1 <<< 2) ||| (c2 <<< 4) ||| (c3 <<< 6)
+
+/-- Pack two 4-bit codes, low nibble first. -/
+def pack4 (a b : Nat) : Nat := a ||| (b <<< 4)
+
+/-- Unpack field `k` of width `bits`. -/
+def field (byte k bits : Nat) : Nat := (byte >>> (k * bits)) &&& ((1 <<< bits) - 1)
+
+/-- Four 2-bit codes round-trip through one byte, in order. -/

+    field (pack2 c0 c1 c2 c3) 0 2 = c0 ∧ field (pack2 c0 c1 c2 c3) 1 2 = c1 ∧
+    field (pack2 c0 c1 c2 c3) 2 2 = c2 ∧ field (pack2 c0 c1 c2 c3) 3 2 = c3 := by
+  decide

+/-- The packed 2-bit byte fits in 8 bits. -/

+  decide

+/-- Two 4-bit codes round-trip through one byte. -/
+theorem pack4_roundtrip : ∀ a : Nat, a < 16 → ∀ b : Nat, b < 16 →

part: loader: reads the 8 named tensor groups from the .safetensors files, validates dtype and shape against the model config, and maps the BF16 buffers into pinned GPU device memory
part: embed: gathers BF16 embedding rows by token ID from embed_tokens.weight into the initial hidden-state buffer for each position in the batch
part: layer_norm: applies a weighted RMS normalization in-place to the hidden state using one input_layernorm or post_attention_layernorm weight vector
part: gdn: runs one GDN (linear-attention) sub-layer: projects the hidden state to (qkv, z, a, b) via in_proj_*, applies the depthwise conv1d, runs the selective-scan recurrence with A_log and dt_bias, applies the sub-layer norm, gates by z, and projects back to hidden size via out_proj
part: qsa: runs one QSA (full-attention) sub-layer: projects the hidden state to (k, v) via k_proj and v_proj, applies per-head q_norm and k_norm, applies mRoPE, appends to the KV cache, and projects the attended output back to hidden size via o_proj
part: moe: runs one MoE FFN block: multiplies the hidden state by mlp.gate.weight to get router logits, selects top-8 experts (kernels in u12d8dd5102), runs the shared expert (gate_proj, up_proj → SwiGLU → down_proj), gates the shared contribution with shared_expert_gate, and sums all contributions
part: visual: runs the full ViT vision encoder: projects image patches via patch_embed.proj (3-D conv), adds pos_embed, passes through 27 transformer blocks (norm1 → QKV → proj → norm2 → MLP), and applies the two-layer merger MLP (norm → linear_fc1 → GELU → linear_fc2) to yield per-patch hidden-state vectors
part: mtp: runs the MTP drafter: applies pre_fc_norm_embedding and pre_fc_norm_hidden to the respective inputs, concatenates and projects through fc.weight to form the MTP hidden state, then runs one transformer layer (input_layernorm → QSA sub-layer → post_attention_layernorm → MoE FFN) using the mtp.layers.{i}.* weights, and applies mtp.norm at the end
